opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Kan. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed informa pauperis granted. Cer-tiorari granted. In addition to the question presented by the petition, the parties are directed to brief and argue the following questions: “Does this Court have jurisdiction to review the judgment of the Kansas Supreme Court under 28 U. S. C. § 1257, as construed by Cox Broadcasting Corp. v. Cohn, 420 U. S. 469 (1975)?”; “Was the Kansas Supreme Court’s judgment adequately supported by a ground independent of federal law?”
